purpose: Glaciers through mass balance, ice motion, front position, runoff, hazards, monitoring, and human dependence.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name glacier, balance year, measure, method, and uncertainty. Distinguish front retreat, area, and mass loss; avoid judging long-term change from one snowy year or photograph.
